notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.short_title: FY26 Renewal - Senior Housing at Victory Plaza
notices.vendor_name: Harlem Congregations for Community Improvement, Inc.
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration renewed its human services contract with Harlem Congregations for Community Improvement, Inc., for senior housing at Victory Plaza, in a renewal worth $1,547,123.

notices.short_title: Requirements Contract for Repair and Replacement of Playground Safety Mats and Sport Surfacing
notices.plain: The Department of Education is seeking bids for a requirements contract to repair and replace playground safety mats and sport surfacing, with the lowest qualified bid to win; responses are due May 14, 2026.
The Department of Education awarded RCM Technologies USA, Inc. a $42,198 renewal contract for assessments for special education services.

notices.short_title: 82625B0039-BEDC - PS-316 Reconstruction of Avenue U Pumping Station
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking bids, due March 24, 2026, for reconstruction of the Avenue U Pumping Station, with the lowest qualified bid to win the work.
The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Malone Creative Group LLC a $10 million contract for creative development of public education, chosen from competing proposals.
The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene awarded Westhab, Inc. a $22.6 million contract for NY 15/15 Congregate Supportive Housing, selected from competing proposals.

notices.agency_name: Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City
notices.short_title: Correction: High Acuity DHS/DSS Technical Assistance
notices.plain: The Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City is seeking proposals from vendors for technical assistance tied to High Acuity DHS/DSS work, with responses due March 2, 2026, in a correction to an earlier notice.

notices.short_title: 82726P0001-Architectural/Engineering Services for the Design of Queens Community District 1 Garage and Salt Shed
notices.plain: The Department of Sanitation is seeking architectural and engineering firms to design a garage and salt shed for Queens Community District 1, choosing from competing proposals due March 31, 2026.
The Department of Transportation awarded American Traffic Solutions, Inc. a $998,468,155 contract for its Automated Enforcement Program, chosen from competing proposals.

notices.short_title: Developed Markets ex USA Active Equity Investment Management Services
notices.plain: The city comptroller's office is seeking public comment on its contract awards for active equity investment management services in developed markets outside the United States.
The Bronx County District Attorney's Office has published a notice about bar exam coaching for attorneys, but the title is the only detail it gives.
The Department of Finance is seeking public comment on its proposed award of services for an automated reconciliation tool from Trintech.
The Department of Sanitation is seeking public comment on a proposed renewal of its software license with Rancher, a notice dated Feb. 10, 2026, states only by its title.

notices.short_title: PUBLIC NOTICE OF A SCOPING MEETING, Columbia Heights Rezoning, CEQR No. 26DCP094K
notices.plain: The Department of City Planning will hold a public scoping meeting on March 12, 2026, about the proposed Columbia Heights rezoning, which is under environmental review.

notices.short_title: New York City Housing Authority Board Meeting
notices.plain: The New York City Housing Authority will hold its Board Meeting on Feb. 24, 2026.
The Landmarks Preservation Commission will hold a public hearing and meeting on Feb. 24, 2026, to take up the items on its agenda.

notices.short_title: Positive Declaration, Columbia Heights Rezoning, CEQR No. 26DCP094K
notices.plain: The Department of City Planning issued a positive declaration on the Columbia Heights Rezoning, which means the proposed rezoning may have a significant environmental impact and requires further review.
